title: Arabic discovery and reminder reliability verified
summary: Arabic and English browser flows pass; reminder scheduling, permissions, renewal and rollback pass automated checks.

changes.detail: Complete authored Arabic text for the eight-step AI discovery, Arabic experiment explanations and controls; teacher language defaults to interface language.
Serialize reminder saves, check permission/channel, verify staged schedules before cancelling old reminders, refill low batches on app foreground and update notification language.
Replace generic reminder settings with pending counts, specific recovery errors, native settings link and five-second test. Collapse long step outline on small screens.

validation.name: Automated regression tests
validation.detail: 59 focused tests passed across Arabic discovery, learning reminders, release behavior, notification navigation, discovery player, wellness native/browser reminders and Change History. Eleven reminder/release tests reran successfully after preserving pending times during renewal.

validation.name: TypeScript, lint and export

validation.name: Browser interaction and visual review
validation.detail: Arabic light and dark: eight steps, experiments, incorrect/correct answers, mobile overflow, Arabic tutor language, disabled native-only web notification test and daily-routine navigation passed. English discovery walkthrough passed. Auth/session APIs mocked. Arabic mobile screenshot inspected. Test selectors and mock session response were corrected during validation.

validation.detail: Append-only history check passed with all prior records retained.
